description: This Swift file defines a SwiftUI view named `OpenClawChatView` which is the main UI component for a chat interface within the OpenClaw project. It manages message display, loading state, errors, and user interactions like scrolling and session switching. The code includes subclasses for various UI elements such as message bubbles and notice banners.

classes.name: OpenClawChatView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a chat interface, handling message display, scrolling, and user interactions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the chat view with a view model and style parameters.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout for the chat, including message list and input composer.

methods.name: messageList
methods.description: Constructs the message list view with scrolling, loading indicator, and overlay elements.

methods.name: messageListRows
methods.description: Generates the individual message bubbles and auxiliary elements like typing indicator and tool calls.

methods.name: visibleMessages
methods.description: Computes the list of messages currently visible, applying filters based on style.

methods.name: errorPresentation
methods.description: Provides error dialog details based on error string.

methods.name: mergeToolResults
methods.description: Merges tool result messages into previous messages for display.

methods.name: isToolResultMessage
methods.description: Checks if a message is a tool result.

methods.name: shouldDisplayMessage
methods.description: Determines if a message should be shown based on its content and context.

methods.name: primaryText
methods.description: Extracts primary display text from a message.

methods.name: hasInlineAttachments
methods.description: Checks if a message contains inline attachments.

methods.name: toolCalls
methods.description: Retrieves tool call contents from a message.

methods.name: inlineToolResults
methods.description: Retrieves inline tool result contents from a message.

methods.name: toolCallIds
methods.description: Collects set of tool call IDs associated with a message.

methods.name: toolResultText
methods.description: Extracts the text from a tool result message.

methods.name: dismissKeyboardIfNeeded
methods.description: Hides the keyboard on supported platforms.
